**Subject: Tuesday reading club – attendance update and a quick apology**

Dear Niamh,

I wanted to get in touch before our review meeting on Wednesday 18 November with an update on the Tuesday reading club at Knocknacarra library. I was delighted to see 14 children there last Tuesday, 3 November. We had five most weeks in September, then nine by mid-October, so the change has been lovely to see.

The club has been running in the upstairs meeting room from 3.30 to 4.45 since September 2025. I know your email of 30 October said it was to be paused from January, with attendance and the increase in hall insurance costs among the reasons. I understand those pressures, but I hope the recent numbers give us something useful to consider before that decision is finalised.

There have been some heartening moments along the way, too. Two sisters from a Ukrainian family joined us in October, and the older one now reads to her younger sister in English at the end of each session. Another child who wouldn’t open a book in September asked last week if he could take two home. We’ve also had a generous donation of 120 books from Declan Moran at Salthill Book Nook. Most are for the six-to-nine age group, and a good few are as Gaeilge.

I should also tell you about something I got wrong. I met Orla Keane, a reporter with the *Corrib Courier*, at the farmers’ market and got carried away talking about the club. I told her she could come along on any Tuesday. She is hoping to visit on Tuesday 24 November with a photographer. I know I should have checked with you first, and I was wrong not to do so—plain and simple.

I’m sorry for putting you in that position. I know our policy is that photographs of children need your sign-off and parental consent forms. The coverage could be wonderful for the club, but only if it’s arranged properly and everyone is comfortable with it. I’m very happy to ring Orla and put the visit on hold until you’ve had a chance to decide what, if anything, should go ahead. If you’re content for us to explore it, I can also collect the consent forms myself.

Would you be willing to look at the new attendance figures before the 18th and reconsider the January pause in light of them? I know numbers are only one part of the picture, and I don’t want to presume what the review will decide. It would just be a pity to pause the club now, just as it seems to be taking off.

Thank you for everything you do to coordinate the volunteers. I’m looking forward to talking it through with you at the review.

Warm regards,  
[Your name]
